title: Maricel Soriano, Maris Racal tie for Best Actress at PMPC Star Awards 2026
summary: Diamond Star Maricel Soriano and Maris Racal both brought home their Best Actress Awards after tying at the 42nd Philippine Movie Press Club (PMPC) Star Awards for Movies for their respective movies.…

blocks.text: Diamond Star Maricel Soriano and Maris Racal both brought home their Best Actress Awards after tying at the 42nd Philippine Movie Press Club (PMPC) Star Awards for Movies for their respective movies. Soriano and Racal received their awards at the PMPC Gabi ng Parangal held Monday night at the Winford Hotel in Manila, for their respective performances in the drama movies “Meet, Greet and Bye,” and “Sunshine.” READ: ‘Quezon,’ Vice Ganda, Maricel Soriano among 2026 PMPC Star Awards for Movies nominees Jericho Rosales won Best Actor for his title role in the biopic “Quezon,” but his award was recieved by director […]...
